inspection.rectangle_convention: Normalized [x, y, width, height] relative to original image. Bounds are visual estimates, not segmentation. Expand small hit targets for usability.
visual_cautions: Every room and nearly every close-up has baked top-bar placeholder [Opened]/8 and Saved. They are not runtime state. S13 omits the common top bar; S10 uses a different Back/customer/Put down header.
R04 board has five pre-existing pinned decorative pages. These are concept marks, not collected evidence. Cover the inner board with a runtime surface when representing player placement.
S06 and S13 use a different apparent body face from the requested Mali. Keep live text as Amatic SC headings and Mali body; replace baked content within paper/monitor bounds.

S05 contains [Customer], [Authored customer line] and [Authored topic]. No authored borrower dialogue is supplied by this image. Show only source-backed narrative or clearly identified visual-study placeholder.
S06 labels Profile source and Last updated are layout placeholders, not evidence metadata. Do not invent timestamps or record attribution.
S13 shows five placeholder review rows whereas the round is eight cases. Runtime must show reached dossiers only and support all eight.
S14 shows all eight structurally complete and asks Submit round; do not expose this as real completeness or final confirmation in an unconnected visual trial.
S15 and S16 contain consequence, source review, result and classification placeholders. No report meaning or grading may be derived from these pixels.
The supplied customer is one unnamed generic male visual and must not silently become the likeness of all eight authored borrowers.
No P00, S01, S03, S04, S07, S17, S18, S19 or S20 standalone artwork was supplied. Build missing utility surfaces with live components or retain them as unimplemented in a concept-only route.
